steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with one vendor bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Allow buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case.
Open the RFQ stage named by the case.
Open the RFQ Responses tab before using its Settings menu.
Open the Recreate Order window from the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Confirm the Recreate Order window is open for the live RFQ.

args.goal: In the open Recreate Order window, first enter a delivery date before today and click Create Order, recording any visible field error or refusal, whether the window remains open, and whether a new order appears; then reopen the window if needed, clear Delivery Date, enable Schedule this event?, leave Select date and Select time empty, click Create Order, and record the visible response, window state, and whether a new order appears.

steps.note: Perform both invalid attempts exactly as specified and capture the app's visible responses without inventing message text.
Assert that the incomplete scheduled-event attempt leaves the Recreate Order dialog available for inspection rather than silently navigating away.
